[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 150
- Description: Bilibili × DeepSeek Harness — feasibility research, QR-login live-fire, and risk-control diagnosis
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/biliup/biliup-rs
  - https://github.com/matkaparka/bilibili-mcp
  - https://github.com/Userluckytian/dsh-bili-workbench
  
  Details:
  > **Note on `pr_urls`:** no PRs were opened and no repos were modified for this work — the governor stopped the line of work before implementation. The URLs listed are the **reference projects consulted during research**, not evidence of merged code.
  
  ## Scope
  
  Governor asked: research the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) codebases to determine how AI could manage a Bilibili account, then implement + deploy a QR-login handshake and live-fire it so the account could be linked.
  
  Outcome: **handshake built and live-fired; Bilibili refused the link.** Governor called the result not useful and stopped the work. This contribution covers research, investigation, diagnostics and a working throwaway script — not shipped code.
  
  ## 1. Research — DeepSeek Harness (dsh) + Bilibili ecosystem
  
  - Searched `agentic_ai_context` and org-wide code first: **0 hits** for `DeepSeek harness`, `bilibili`. Nothing internal existed; greenfield research.
  - Established what dsh is: an agent harness with **skills** (`SKILL.md`) and **plugins**, configured not via `mcp.json` but via a **Cordis patch file** (`~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`), with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` as the generic escape hatch for any MCP server.
  - Mapped the existing Bilibili plugin/MCP landscape:
  
  | Project | Capability |
  |---|---|
  | `moxingovo/dsh-bilibili` | search, meta, subtitles, playurl — read-only |
  | `CZX2244/dsh-bilibili`, `Sacredbluedragon/dsh-bili-watch` | meta/comments/danmaku/ASR/OCR — read-only |
  | `13520rygvv/dsh-bili-video` | **QR login**, comments, 三连, 私信 |
  | `Userluckytian/dsh-bili-workbench` | material library → AI remix → **投稿 publish** |
  | `matkaparka/bilibili-mcp` | QR login + **upload** (27 tools) |
  | `biliup/biliup-rs` | mature CLI: QR login + upload |
  
  - Key structural finding: **Bilibili has no open publishing API for individuals.** Every working path is cookie/session automation, so the credential is the crown jewel and the whole risk surface.
  - Documented the Oct-2026 `Set-Cookie` regression: the session cookie moved from the response **body** to the **header**, silently breaking older parsers into writing four empty fields while still reporting "已登录".
  
  ## 2. Build — QR-login handshake
  
  Wrote a standalone, self-contained script rather than routing through a service deploy, specifically so the live-fire could not be interrupted by a brain restart mid-turn:
  
  - `GET passport/x/passport-login/web/qrcode/generate` → `qrcode_key`
  - Rendered QR to PNG (no extra deps — `qrcode`/`PIL` already present; **zero installs**)
  - Spawned a **detached** poller (`start_new_session`) polling every 2 s — a chat turn cannot stay open for 3 minutes, so the poller had to outlive the turn
  - On `code:0`: parsed `Set-Cookie` headers **and** the callback URL query, with a hard invariant that **`SESSDATA` must be non-empty** — `code:0` alone is explicitly NOT success
  - Captured `refresh_token` for renewal without re-scanning
  - Verified via `nav` (`isLogin`, `uname`, `mid`) as the only proof-of-link
  
  Credential handling: `0600` files outside the repo, never echoed to chat, never committed.
  
  ## 3. Live-fire — result: rejected
  
  | Time (UTC) | Event |
  |---|---|
  | 08:47:42 | QR `a20c7a29…` generated, PNG delivered to governor's channel |
  | 09:17:20 | A second QR generated — **unexplained**, most likely the goal-loop auto-advance re-running the generate step |
  | 09:18:12 | `86090 二维码已扫码未确认` — governor's scan registered |
  | 09:18:17+ | `{"code":48007,"message":"当前账号暂不支持在本APP登录","data":null}` |
  | — | **`Set-Cookie` count: 0.** No credential written, nothing to revoke, nothing leaked. |
  
  ## 4. Diagnosis — reachability matrix from the autopilot box (`3.214.167.219`, Ashburn, AS14618 Amazon)
  
  | Surface | Result |
  |---|---|
  | `qrcode/generate` | ✅ works |
  | `qrcode/poll` (control, fresh key) | ✅ `86101` — endpoint healthy, so `48007` was the scan, not the endpoint |
  | `x/frontend/finger/spi` | ✅ mints buvid cookies |
  | `search/all/v2` | ✅ **`code:0`, real data** (parsed actual rows: 「可可」 104.7万 views etc.) |
  | `ranking/v2` | ✅ **`code:0`, real `aid` list** |
  | `nav` | ✅ `-101 账号未登录` (correctly formed) |
  | `web-interface/view` | ❌ `-412 request was banned` |
  | `space/wbi/acc/info` | ❌ `-352 风控校验失败` |
  | `www.bilibili.com/video/BV…` | ❌ **HTTP 412** |
  | `space.bilibili.com/1` | ❌ **HTTP 412** |
  
  **Conclusion:** `48007`, `-352` and `-412` are one family — risk control on a datacenter IP. CDN-cached discovery paths resolve; anything opening a session or touching a user-scoped resource is scored and refused. A login must originate from a normal egress. Three independent refusals judged sufficient evidence to stop.
  
  ## 5. Defects found (documented, not fixed — work stopped)
  
  1. **Parser gap:** envelope-level errors (`data:null`, code outside the 86xxx state machine) made the poller spin 30 s printing `code=None`, burying the real `48007`. Patched on the box to fail fast with `{"status":"rejected","code":48007}`. Not merged anywhere.
  2. **No single-flight lock:** a second `generate` silently overwrote `qr_login.png` and orphaned the first poller, so governor and agent were looking at two different QR cycles.
  3. SRE note: `pkill -f "bilibili_qr_login.py poll"` matched and killed the SSH command's own process line. Target pollers by PID, not by `-f` pattern.
  
  ## 6. Honest assessment
  
  The only zero-risk surface proven to work from this box is **read-only discovery** (keyword search + ranking) — no credential, never touches the account. Everything else (subtitles, danmaku, space pages, posting, engagement) is blocked by IP-class risk control and would need CN-adjacent egress plus a registered developer app. Governor judged the work not worth continuing; stopped as directed.
  
  No repos modified, no PRs opened, no production deploys, no credentials persisted. The throwaway script sits at `/opt/truesight_autopilot/bilibili/bilibili_qr_login.py`, unused.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 250.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
